insert into srm_eval (comp_cd, eval_no, cust_id, tmpl_id, period_from, period_to, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{evalNo}, #{custId}, #{tmplId}, #{from}, #{to}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning eval_id
mapper.insert: insert into srm_eval_score (comp_cd, eval_id, item_id, created_by, updated_by) select comp_cd, #{evalId}, item_id, #{by}, #{by} from srm_eval_item where tmpl_id = #{tmplId} order by item_no
mapper.update: update srm_eval set remark = #{remark}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where eval_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
update srm_eval_score set comment = #{comment}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where eval_id = #{evalId} and item_id = #{itemId} and comment is distinct from #{comment}::varchar

update srm_eval_score set auto_yn = #{autoYn}, score = case when #{autoYn} = 'Y' then #{score}::numeric else score end, raw_value = #{rawValue}, basis = #{basis}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where eval_id = #{evalId} and item_id = #{itemId} and (auto_yn is distinct from #{autoYn}::char or raw_value is distinct from #{rawValue}::numeric or basis is distinct from #{basis}::varchar or (#{autoYn} = 'Y' and score is distinct from #{score}::numeric))
mapper.select: select count(*) as due_cnt, count(*) filter (where coalesce((select sum(r.qty) from srm_po_receipt r where r.po_line_id = l.po_line_id and r.occurred_on <= l.due_date), 0) >= l.qty - l.cancel_qty) as on_time_cnt from srm_po_line l join srm_po p on p.po_id = l.po_id where p.cust_id = #{custId} and p.source = 'SRM' and p.status in ('ISSUED', 'ACKED', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED', 'RECEIVED', 'CLOSED') and l.line_status <> 'CANCELLED' and l.qty - l.cancel_qty > 0 and l.due_date between #{from} and #{to}

select count(*) as current_cnt, min(x.expires_on) as min_expires from (select distinct on (c.cert_type_cd) c.cert_type_cd, c.expires_on from srm_supplier_cert c where c.cust_id = #{custId} and c.use_yn = 'Y' and c.issued_on <= #{on} order by c.cert_type_cd, c.issued_on desc, c.cert_id desc) x
